definitions.heldCalls: Distinct held prospect calls or meetings involving Charles; scheduled, canceled, no-show, internal, recruiting and asynchronous exchanges are excluded.
definitions.qualifiedCompanies: Distinct Charles-qualified companies among the selected period's confirmed held prospect calls. Qualification is the latest recorded owner decision as of the stated review date.
definitions.opportunityAcceptances: Distinct commercial opportunities explicitly accepted by Charles with an active next step, counted by the original acceptance date. New CRM records and stage labels alone do not establish acceptance.
definitions.clientWins: Distinct companies becoming a client for the first time under Charles's commercial ownership, counted by the verified first win date. Renewals, expansions and reopened records are excluded.

heldCalls.note: Only the bounded owner-confirmed linked calls are available. The complete Charles prospect-meeting register has not been reconciled.

qualification.note: Known call dispositions are retained; qualification for all companies Charles met has not been reviewed.

opportunityAcceptances.note: Explicit acceptance dates and next steps need Charles's review. CRM record creation is not an accepted opportunity.

clientWins.note: First-client win dates and the existing-client baseline need owner confirmation. A CRM Closed Won stage label is insufficient.

notes: The existing owner-confirmed NuVee and Venus calls are imported from OWNER_CONFIRMATIONS.json, which remains their canonical record.
A positive confirmed count under incomplete coverage is a lower bound. An empty incomplete register is pending, not zero.
The four period measures use different units and event cohorts; they are not a conversion funnel.
